definition: Services with at least 20 requests due in each of the two weeks.
label: observed
derivation: 311 requests (City of St. Louis open data, csb.zip yearly CSVs, invalid bytes dropped, one row per request number), as loaded by N1 into build/stl.duckdb; each request graded against its own promised date (N1 view promise), this week's due requests against last week's; cancelled requests left out.

period: residential pothole requests filed 6 Apr to 4 Oct 2026, closed by 13 Oct 2026
definition: First week of 2026 in which fewer than half of closed residential pothole requests (at least 15) were closed within CityStat's 8-day goal.
label: observed
derivation: 311 requests (City of St. Louis open data, csb.zip yearly CSVs, invalid bytes dropped, one row per request number), as loaded by N1 into build/stl.duckdb; residential pothole requests grouped by the week filed; share of closed requests closed within 8 days of filing (CityStat's goal and definition C, which N4 found reproduces CityStat's counts); weeks with fewer than 15 closed requests not used. Recent weeks still have open requests, so their shares can only fall.

period: resident requests filed 16 May 2025 to 13 Oct 2026
definition: Median days to the first-step closing, by ward, for towing tags and cave-in referrals.
label: observed
derivation: 311 requests (City of St. Louis open data, csb.zip yearly CSVs, invalid bytes dropped, one row per request number), as loaded by N1 into build/stl.duckdb; resident channels only; ward from the published WARD column, blank wards left out, so a city analyst can reproduce it from the CSV without GIS; only closures with the same closing words, so the comparison is like for like (N3's method, recomputed by ward).

definition: Cave-in requests closed as referred to Street Maintenance in the last 90 days.
label: observed
derivation: 311 requests (City of St. Louis open data, csb.zip yearly CSVs, invalid bytes dropped, one row per request number), as loaded by N1 into build/stl.duckdb; closing words matched exactly; the city publishes no repair date for these, so none can be joined.

definition: Resident LRA-lot weed requests closed "on schedule" or "added to rotation" within 3 days with no cut billed after (N1's parcel join).
label: observed
note: Retired for public use 14 Oct 2026: N1's wider parcel join; earlier runs counted all channels (103 on 82 lots). The brief and every public text use N5's registered resident-filed count, n5_funnel_no_cut_requests and n5_funnel_no_cut_lots (94 on 75).
derivation: 311 requests (City of St. Louis open data, csb.zip yearly CSVs, invalid bytes dropped, one row per request number), as loaded by N1 into build/stl.duckdb, joined by N1 to parcels and to the Forestry billing ledger; land-bank ownership from the LRA inventory.

definition: Inspect City Tree requests cancelled with no words at the same address as a removal order started more than a day before (N1's join).
label: observed
note: Retired for public use 14 Oct 2026: an earlier version counted removal orders within 30 m (499) under an 'at the address' definition. The brief and every public text use N5's exact-address count, n5_tree_cancel_blank_wo_predates (288, median 575 days).
derivation: 311 requests (City of St. Louis open data, csb.zip yearly CSVs, invalid bytes dropped, one row per request number), as loaded by N1 into build/stl.duckdb, joined by N1 to the city's published Cityworks tree work-order saved searches by normalised address.
